RULES: Total maintained interior volume shares Strength capacity. Potential entrances may be established broadly; Skill limits simultaneously active/open entrances. Multiple entrances may connect to the same space. Direct portal connections use negligible interior volume. Spaces persist while allocated and need no concentration. Sealing preserves contents and allocated volume. Occupied/nonempty space remains real while maintained. Spaces/openings may be anchored or mobile. Continuous Connection allows matter, energy and signals to remain continuous through openings. Closing an opening intersecting matter can physically sever it; hostile use follows normal combat/defense rules. Moving portals provide spatial access rather than unlimited mechanical force. Long-distance travel through compressed space is an actual journey. Initial atmosphere/environment derives from surroundings and is finite; improved habitat control may be learned. Momentum is preserved by default; exit orientation can redirect direction rather than speed.

DOMAIN AND ACCESS: Unlimited established closed access points may exist; only simultaneous OPEN openings count toward Skill limits. At Skill 7+, distribute active openings among spaces freely. The creator designs domain architecture, environments, matter/energy, inhabitants or servants, permissions, passwords, and internal conditions within the Power's capacity. Manifested domain matter generally dissolves outside; nourishment, hydration, and healing already received within remain effective. Accessing other dimensions may require a Skill check; navigating uses Cleverness + Skill. Temporarily bending another dimension's rules uses Brilliance + Strength or Cleverness + Skill as appropriate; permanently altering those rules calls for a Strength check. Extradimensional Space does not automatically confer time travel.

RULES: Knowing an illusion is false does not make it invisible. Investigation occurs when observers have reason to question it. Physical evidence can reveal its nature. Illusions have major combat utility through concealment, decoys, false terrain, false threats, sensory masking, misleading positions and targeting information.

ADDITIONAL EFFECTS: A coherent multisensory illusion counts as one illusion. Camouflage and invisibility are sophisticated sensory techniques. Illusions can inflict actual energy-based harm at Power Strength −3, or provide physically appropriate defense at Strength −3 (or −2 where particularly fitting). MASTERY OF REALITY / ILLUSORY ACTUALIZATION requires Strength 13+: at Skill 14 an extreme-effort check can briefly actualize an illusion; at Skill 15 an extreme-effort check can sustain actualization for up to half normal duration; at Skill 16 actualization is reliable for full duration. Actualized matter is physically real during its existence; lasting consequences of its actions remain after it disappears.

BIO SCAN: Maps a specific living body. Check reveals anatomy, injury, disease, tissues, circulation, nerves, organs, toxins, adaptations and differences. Successful scan provides biological knowledge for attempts on that individual; execution may still require a check. Scan accurately observes the individual but contextual knowledge distinguishes baseline variation, mutation, adaptation, disease or engineering.

RULES: Healing progresses accelerate→repair→regenerate→reconstruct. Natural repair is permanent. Biological Regulation includes bleeding, shock, breathing, circulation, temperature, fatigue, recovery, immune response, toxins and infection. Adaptation creates temporary useful biological configurations. Limited alteration supports real surgery/disguise-scale biological changes. If a physical change could reasonably be achieved by surgery/medical procedure, Bio can potentially perform it directly. Power Skill supplies execution rather than automatic medical knowledge; background/research/instruction/observation/consultation supply knowledge. Major regeneration requires nutrients/raw biological resources; matter is not created. Time and physical condition influence extreme restoration. Death restoration returns the same organism/person. Advanced rejuvenation and age regulation are possible at sufficient Skill. Sustainable biological repair remains permanent; extraordinary transformations and genetic/anatomical enhancements last for the Strength Base Duration. A sufficiently skilled character may continually maintain personal rejuvenation and potentially avoid biological aging, without becoming invulnerable. Rejuvenated others resume ordinary aging after treatment. At advanced Skill, an autonomous maintenance regimen may sustain another person up to Strength Base Duration (one year at Strength 16), after which it requires renewal. Passive self-healing and reflexive stabilization against injury or shock operate even while unconscious; deliberate self-optimization remains a conscious choice.

ATTRIBUTE ENHANCEMENT:

Choose one Physical Attribute for full bonus and one Mental for half bonus rounded up.

Skill1–3 +1/+1

4–6 +2/+1

7–9 +3/+2

10–12 +4/+2

13–15 +5/+3

May take less/omit secondary. Adaptation must biologically support chosen Attributes. Mental enhancement adds no knowledge, experience or personality. Normal Attribute ceiling16.

TEMPORAL BURST:

Skill1–6 none.

7–9 +1 extra turn.

10–12 +2.

13–15 +3.

16 +4.

Extra turns are full normal turns and may be flexibly scheduled.

Recharge after using N extra turns = N + Nd6 rounds after burst round:

+1 =2–7 rounds

+2 =4–14

+3 =6–21

+4 =8–28

Temporal powers remain usable during Burst. Recharge follows manipulator’s personal timeline and temporal travel does not reset it.

Grant Burst:

Self automatic.

Give all extras to one willing other: DC13; failure gives entire Burst to manipulator.

Split among multiple recipients: DC15; failure gives all extras to first named recipient.

Manipulator bears recharge for total extras.

RULES: Travel to the past changes history and its consequences. The setting may use a mutable single timeline or branching timelines, but the traveler experiences the altered present as continuous reality, with no automatic evidence that a branch exists. The traveler retains personally experienced memories; other people generally remember the resulting history. Larger changes can have broader ripples. The GE does not announce or reveal timeline cosmology without an in-story reason. Traverse and Jump retain their established distinct movement methods and Strength Reach limits.

Hostile temporal effects use normal delivery/application defenses. Once successfully subjected, ordinary biology/Endurance does not independently resist time itself. Temporal fields affect the portion physically inside them; precise partial effects may be surgical. Connected objects continue mechanically interacting across temporal boundaries.

Strength Reach remains maximum backward/forward travel reach through ordinary Temporal Manipulation; Skill16 Outside Time may later reveal exceptional possibilities.

TEMPORAL INTERACTION AND FLOW: Accelerating or slowing one's time changes perception, thought, reflexes and physical action together. Objects and people directly interacted with participate as necessary for ordinary handling, opening doors, writing or carrying; do not add separate target bookkeeping for such interaction. Stasis entails no experienced passage of time. Flow reversal actually returns only the selected target or field to an earlier state while outside time continues forward. Rewinding an injured body can remove its wound without restoring torn clothing, spilled blood or environmental damage outside the field. Rewinding an exploded bomb can restore the bomb without undoing casualties or destruction beyond the chosen field. A reversed projectile can retrace its earlier path without returning a moved weapon. A sufficiently skilled manipulator may selectively preserve a reversed subject's memories; other Powers or exceptional mental abilities may help retain or reconstruct memories. Memory preservation or loss is not automatically universal.

TECHNOPATHIC INTERACTION:

At sufficient Skill, EM directly interfaces with electromagnetic/electronic systems. Cooperative ordinary technology generally requires no check. EM provides interface/control; knowledge and reasoning still matter.

When challenged:

1d6 + appropriate Mental Attribute + EM Power Skill.

Brilliance: understand architecture, encryption, algorithms, unfamiliar/quantum technology.

Cleverness: intrusion, spoofing, exploitation, improvisation and unconventional routes.

Presence: social interaction, persuasion, deception or grifting of sufficiently intelligent AI.

Typical automated security Challenge:

Simple/consumer 10

Professional 13

Hardened 16

Exceptional 19

Superhuman/exotic 22+

Active intelligent defenders use normal opposed-check rules and applicable Attributes/Powers. Ties favor defender when attacker seeks to alter existing state.

Successful intrusion accomplishes the specific attempted objective; sophisticated systems may require multiple meaningful objectives rather than one roll granting total control.

AI remains an actor. EM can communicate with AI at machine speed where hardware permits and can attack/control its electromagnetic hardware/interfaces; a security success does not automatically control a sentient AI’s mind.

Quantum computers can be accessed through their electromagnetic hardware, controls, sensors and interfaces. Power Skill permits interaction; Brilliance/Cleverness and acquired knowledge govern understanding and exploitation.

Air gaps block conventional networking but do not inherently block direct EM interaction within Power range. Effective electromagnetic shielding/Faraday-style or exotic appropriate defenses can interfere with access.

Passive Reception can exceed active Power Range when a signal itself reaches the character. Strength Range limits active imposition/control, not reception of broadcasts already arriving.

Physical consequences persist: fried electronics remain damaged, heated objects remain hot, ignited fires remain burning. Sustained EM effects can be maintained reasonably without a separate duration rating.

CORE: Create temporary scaled duplicates of an original. The original remains unchanged and safe. Multiple duplicates of the same or different originals may exist at different sizes within normal capacity.

INFORMATION-PATTERN RECONSTRUCTION:

Scale Duplication reads the original as an informational pattern and constructs a new temporary instance at the chosen scale from the same supernatural source that powers Genesis abilities. The original supplies the pattern, not physical matter.

The duplicate’s substance reflects the underlying source of Powers in the setting: divine spark, magic, ectoplasm, ethereal matter, cosmic energy, or another established source.

The Power sustains the reconstruction. Duplicate limits and duration represent how many reconstructions the character can maintain and for how long.

SCALED PHYSICS:

Scaled duplicates have mass, volume, and ordinary density appropriate to their new size.

Living functional duplicates retain the original’s Attributes and learned Power capabilities to the fidelity permitted by Scale Duplication Skill.

Size still changes geometry and physical interaction. Reach, grip size, leverage, traction, contact area, visibility, access, and environmental obstacles remain scale-dependent.

Reduction does not inherently increase density, Strength, or Endurance.

Enlargement does not inherently reduce Attributes or create additional Attribute ratings.

A tiny duplicate with preserved Strength can exert the original’s Strength when it can obtain usable leverage, anchoring, grip, or another physically workable method.

Movement Powers retain their normal ratings. Scale changes the environment in which movement occurs rather than reducing the Power rating.

SKILL:

Scaled sensory duplicates and decoys; self and simple subjects.

4–6 Basic Physical Duplication:

Material but fragile duplicates; broader ordinary matter and biology.

7–9 Realistic Material Duplication:

Living duplicates function as living beings; appropriate machinery functions; preserved Attributes and Powers where fidelity supports them; improved Duplicate Sacrifice.

13–15 Semi-Autonomous Duplication:

Sophisticated living duplicates may possess duplicated memories and personality; advanced control and control handoff; Duplicate Merge.

16 Exceptional Duplication:

Highest fidelity, including extraordinary or exotic substances and phenomena where appropriate, such as radioactive material and supernatural or fictional materials.

A character may intentionally use lower fidelity. Each full fidelity tier below maximum reduces Challenge Rating by 1 when a check is required.

SCALE CONTROL — Skill 7+:

Choose any size differential within Strength limits rather than only fixed doubling or halving. Functional coherence improves with Skill.

DUPLICATE SACRIFICE — Skill 7+:

Sacrifice one duplicate from an original; it disappears.

Duration option: double the maximum duration of every surviving duplicate from that same original, measured from original creation time. This changes expiration rather than restarting the clock. Repeated sacrifices may continue while at least two duplicates remain.

Repair option Skill 7–9: sacrifice one duplicate to repair one surviving duplicate from the same original.

Repair option Skill 10+: sacrifice one duplicate to repair all remaining duplicates from that original.

The size of the sacrificed duplicate does not change the effect.

DUPLICATE MERGE — Skill 13+:

Merge multiple duplicates of the same original into one larger or more powerful duplicate. Contributors are consumed.

Number, scale, Strength, and circumstances determine the plausible merged result. Duplicate Merge is an exertion/story-scale technique rather than repeatable exponential arithmetic and does not establish a new normal Enlargement ceiling.

At exceptional Skill 16 and Strength 16, an all-in extraordinary merge can potentially reach absurd or planet-scale size under appropriate story circumstances.

Consumed duplicates cannot later be sacrificed. The merged duplicate remains temporary.

CONTROL:

Animate duplicates normally operate under the duplicator’s control.

Higher Skill permits increasing autonomy and control handoff to the original subject, including appropriate senses and movement.

At Skill 13+, sophisticated living duplicates may possess the original’s duplicated memories and personality to the degree established by fidelity. They remain temporary reconstructions derived from the original’s informational pattern.
